title: The Four-Year Cycle Debate
request: why people say bitcoin's four-year cycle is dead
story: After the 2024 halving and the arrival of spot ETFs, a growing number of analysts and YouTubers argue bitcoin no longer follows its old four-year boom-and-bust rhythm, and that the familiar halving-driven top-and-crash map no longer predicts price.
central_claim: Bitcoin's four-year halving cycle no longer governs its price; the pattern is broken.
not_about: Not about whether bitcoin is a good investment, not about price targets in general, not about the mechanics of halvings or mining economics, and not about other crypto assets.

episodes.title: Origin
episodes.about: How the story got here, oldest first.

videos.title: Bitcoin: It is not a 4 year cycle! (Welcome to the show)
videos.why: Benjamin Cowen, 28 March 2020, is the earliest video here that states the claim itself rather than the topic: "It is not a 4 year cycle." His version rests on lengthening cycles and diminishing returns, not on ETFs, and carries no hard deadline. Earlier videos in the set (Bob Loukas 2019, Nugget's News 2019, 99Bitcoins 2018) assert the halving cycle rather than dispute it.

videos.title: So, Is This a Bitcoin Supercycle or What?
videos.role: 2021-04. New trigger: institutions, not halving; supercycle means no 80% bear
videos.why: The Breakdown lays out the supercycle thesis in its clearest short form: are new institutional participants breaking bitcoin out of the four-year, halving-driven boom-bust pattern? The claim now has a testable consequence attached, no deep bear market. The long first-hand Dan Held interviews from the same weeks run 38 and 58 minutes.

videos.title: 4 Year Cycle: Bitcoin Will Bottom At 24k In November 2022 (According To These Macro Trends)
videos.role: 2022-03. Predicted event failed: deep bear arrived, cycle-intact camp set a dated bottom
videos.why: Six minutes, states a number and a date: bitcoin bottoms near 24k in November 2022 on four-year cycle timing. It marks the point where the no-more-bear-market version of the claim was contradicted and the old map was being used again.

videos.title: WHAT BROKE THE 4 YEAR CYCLE? | Raoul Pal ft Julien Bittel | The Everything Code
videos.role: 2025-10. Trigger changes again: global liquidity and ISM, not the halving
videos.why: Raoul Pal and Julien Bittel state plainly that the classic four-year sine wave has broken and point to debt maturity and liquidity as the replacement clock. Short, on the record, and it is the version most of the later 2026 videos repeat.

videos.title: The 4 Year Cycle Is DEAD!! What It Means For Crypto In 2026!!
videos.role: 2026-01. The expected 2025 blow-off top did not arrive; peak pushed to 2026
videos.why: Coin Bureau names the missed event directly: no blow-off top, a December downturn instead, and draws the conclusion that the pattern has shifted. This is the deadline-passed moment for the standard 18-months-after-halving top.

videos.title: Bitcoin's Halving Cycle Is Weakening — Here's What Replaced It (2026)
videos.role: 2026-05. Mechanism restated: ETF flows said to outweigh the halving supply cut
videos.why: Four minutes on the specific claim that 2025 was the first negative post-halving year and that spot ETF demand, not block reward, now sets the rhythm. It converts the broad liquidity argument into a checkable mechanical claim.
